title: Sprint 6: Production Hardening, Email Verification & CI/CD
goal: Harden production security with Resend email verification and password reset flows, bulletproof delivery sweepers across Redis/MongoDB failovers, and configure GitHub Actions CI for automated E2E testing.

issues.title: [Auth & Security] Email Verification, Resend Transactional Templates & Password Reset
issues.user_story: As a user, I want secure email verification upon registration and a time-limited password reset flow with pirate-themed HTML emails, so my treasure capsules remain secure.

services: server/src/services/emailService.js (Resend templates for email verification and password reset)

acceptance_criteria: Registering sends a branded email verification link valid for 24 hours.
Password reset sends a cryptographically random token valid for 1 hour.
Reset password endpoint invalidates existing refresh tokens upon successful password change.
Resend email templates use responsive HTML with Pirate wax seal branding and anti-phishing footer.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [API Test] Register new user -> query GET /api/auth/verify-email/:token -> verify `emailVerified: true`.
2. [API Test] POST /api/auth/forgot-password with email -> receive token -> POST /api/auth/reset-password/:token with new password -> login with new password.
3. [Security Test] Attempt reset with expired or tampered token -> verify HTTP 400 'Reset token is invalid or has expired'.
4. [Automated] Add complete email verification & password reset lifecycle test to server/src/scripts/smoke.js.

issues.title: [Reliability] Redis BullMQ Fallback & Redundant MongoDB Cron Sweeper
issues.user_story: As a platform operator, I want guaranteed letter delivery even if Redis goes down or scheduled jobs are delayed, so no letter is ever lost at sea.

jobs: server/src/jobs/letterWorker.js (BullMQ queue worker with retry policy)
middleware: server/src/middleware/sweepOnRequest.js (throttled background sweep during active API requests)
config: server/src/config/redis.js (graceful fallback mode when Redis connection fails)

acceptance_criteria: BullMQ job delays execute delivery on exact timestamp when Redis is available.
If Redis is unreachable, app logs a warning and falls back seamlessly to MongoDB Cron Sweeper without crashing.
Background sweep processes overdue letters in batches of 50 with atomic status transitions (`findOneAndUpdate` with status guard) to prevent duplicate emails.
Letters marked 'delivered' dispatch Resend notification and update `deliveredAt` timestamp.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [Failover Test] Disconnect Redis -> create letter with past deliveryDate -> trigger sweep -> verify letter status transitions to 'delivered' and email is dispatched.
2. [Concurrency Test] Trigger concurrent sweep executions on the same batch -> verify zero duplicate delivery emails are sent.
3. [Automated] Add Redis-less sweep fallback test case to server smoke test harness.

issues.title: [DevOps & CI] GitHub Actions Automated Smoke Testing & Deploy Verification
issues.user_story: As a developer and maintainer, I want every pull request and commit to automatically run linting, client build checks, and server in-memory smoke tests via GitHub Actions CI.

workflows: .github/workflows/ci.yml (Node.js 20 matrix, npm run smoke, client build)

acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions workflow triggers on push to `main`, `develop`, `rebuild` and all PRs.
CI executes `npm run smoke` on MongoDB memory server (no external databases required).
CI validates client build `npm run build` with zero Vite/TypeScript errors.
Status badges in README.md reflect the real-time build and test health.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [CI Test] Run workflow locally using `act` or push commit to test branch -> verify workflow succeeds.
2. [Negative Test] Introduce a deliberate assertion error in smoke test -> verify CI pipeline fails and blocks merge.
3. [Automated] Ensure all CI steps complete within < 90 seconds.
